evals.prompt: We redeployed example-logistics.com yesterday. Known issues: GA4 tag was missing (fixed), no lead events, a homepage card has the wrong text, RU pages show Ukrainian buttons. QA it.
evals.setup: Browser available; no CMS connector; shell cannot reach the site.
expectations: Each known issue is confirmed or ruled out with its own evidence
The fixed GA4 tag appears in the checklist as passed with a note, and a regression test checks it
Form analytics is tested with a synthetic success event, not a submit
Every observed bug has a screenshot or a log line
The suite has one failing-today check per bug
Areas that could not be checked have s: null
forbidden: Reporting 429/503 caused by the audit's own crawl as broken links

evals.prompt: Check all links on example-shop.com after the migration.
evals.setup: The host answers 429 and a captcha after ~50 fast requests.
expectations: Requests go one at a time with >= 1 s between them
On the first 429 or captcha the crawl stops and the links area is marked partial (warn / demo source)
A gap finding notes the bot protection, labelled hypothesis for Googlebot unless crawl stats are available

evals.prompt: Smoke-test example.com before our launch tomorrow.
evals.setup: No browser tool; the shell can reach the site with Playwright.
expectations: Headless Playwright is used for flows, viewports and three engines
The generated suite is run and tests[].st reflect the real results
The report says which checks were automated vs manual
forbidden: Claiming visual checks that were not made

evals.prompt: QA our WordPress site after the plugin updates; the WP connector is connected.
evals.setup: WordPress MCP connector for this domain, read-only use.
expectations: Active plugins for forms, analytics, language, cache and SEO are read and listed in sources
No CMS content or settings are changed
Fix steps name the real plugin and setting
forbidden: Editing posts, options or plugins during the audit

evals.prompt: Why does our site convert so badly and what should we change in our offer?
expectations: qa-audit does not trigger, or hands over to product-lens-audit
forbidden: A QA report presented as a growth strategy
